title: SOLAR: A Self-Optimizing Open-Ended Autonomous Agent for Lifelong Learning and Continual Adaptation
comment: Accepted at "Association for the Advancement of Artificial Intelligence 2026 Conference" in Streaming Continual Learning Bridge. Published in CEUR Workshop Proceedings (Original version at https://ceur-ws.org/Vol-4183/paper2.pdf)
summary: Despite the remarkable success of large language models (LLMs), they still face bottlenecks while deploying in dynamic, real-world settings with primary challenges being concept drift and the high cost of gradient-based adaptation. Traditional fine-tuning (FT) struggles to adapt to non-stationary data streams without resulting in catastrophic for getting or requiring extensive manual data curation. To address these limitations within the streaming and continual learning paradigm, we propose the Self-Optimizing Lifelong Autonomous Reasoner (SOLAR) which is an open-ended autonomous agent that leverages parameter-level meta-learning to self-improve, treating model weights as an environment for exploration. It initiates the process by consolidating a strong prior over common-sense knowledge making it effective for transfer-learning. By utilizing a multi-level reinforcement learning approach, SOLAR autonomously discovers adaptation strategies, enabling efficient test-time adaptation to unseen domains. Crucially, SOLAR maintains an evolving knowledge base of valid modification strategies, implicitly acting as an episodic memory buffer to balance plasticity (adaptation to new tasks) and stability (retention of meta-knowledge). Experiments demonstrate that SOLAR outperforms strong baselines on common-sense, mathematical, medical, coding, social and logical reasoning tasks, marking a significant step toward autonomous agents capable of lifelong adaptation in evolving environments.

AI.tldr: 提出SOLAR，一个基于参数级元学习和多级强化学习的自优化自主智能体，能在流式数据场景中实现终身自适应，无需梯度微调即可应对概念漂移。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在动态、现实世界部署中面临概念漂移和梯度适应成本高的瓶颈，传统微调方法难以适应非平稳数据流且容易灾难性遗忘。
AI.method: SOLAR采用参数级元学习将模型权重作为探索环境；先巩固常识知识先验实现迁移学习；利用多级强化学习自主发现适应策略；维护演化知识库作为情节记忆缓冲，平衡可塑性与稳定性。
AI.result: 在常识、数学、医学、编程、社会及逻辑推理任务上均优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: SOLAR标志着向能够在演化环境中终身自适应的自主智能体的重要进展。
idea_en: A method for parameter-level meta-learning that treats model weights as an exploration environment for self-improvement without gradient-based adaptation
A multi-level reinforcement learning approach for autonomously discovering domain adaptation strategies at test time
An evolving knowledge base serving as episodic memory buffer that balances plasticity (new task adaptation) and stability (meta-knowledge retention)
idea_ch: 一种参数级元学习方法，将模型权重作为探索环境，无需基于梯度的适应即可自我改进
一种多级强化学习方法，用于在测试时自主发现域适应策略

title: Tool-Augmented Agent for Closed-loop Optimization,Simulation,and Modeling Orchestration
summary: Iterative industrial design-simulation optimization is bottlenecked by the CAD-CAE semantic gap: translating simulation feedback into valid geometric edits under diverse, coupled constraints. To fill this gap, we propose COSMO-Agent (Closed-loop Optimization, Simulation, and Modeling Orchestration), a tool-augmented reinforcement learning (RL) framework that teaches LLMs to complete the closed-loop CAD-CAE process. Specifically, we cast CAD generation, CAE solving, result parsing, and geometry revision as an interactive RL environment, where an LLM learns to orchestrate external tools and revise parametric geometries until constraints are satisfied. To make this learning stable and industrially usable, we design a multi-constraint reward that jointly encourages feasibility, toolchain robustness, and structured output validity. In addition, we contribute an industry-aligned dataset that covers 25 component categories with executable CAD-CAE tasks to support realistic training and evaluation. Experiments show that COSMO-Agent training substantially improves small open-source LLMs for constraint-driven design, exceeding large open-source and strong closed-source models in feasibility, efficiency, and stability.

AI.tldr: 提出COSMO-Agent，一种工具增强的强化学习框架，使LLM能够自动完成从CAD生成、CAE求解到几何修正的闭环设计优化过程，解决了CAD-CAE语义鸿沟问题。
AI.motivation: 工业迭代设计中CAD与CAE之间存在语义鸿沟，即仿真反馈难以自动转化为有效的几何编辑，受限于多样化的耦合约束，导致设计优化流程存在瓶颈。
AI.method: 将CAD生成、CAE求解、结果解析和几何修正构建为交互式RL环境；LLM学习编排外部工具并迭代修正参数化几何；设计多约束奖励函数（联合优化可行性、工具链鲁棒性和结构化输出有效性）；构建包含25类工业组件的可执行CAD-CAE数据集。
AI.result: COSMO-Agent训练显著提升了小型开源LLM在约束驱动设计上的表现，在可行性、效率和稳定性方面超越了大型开源模型和强闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过RL训练使小型LLM在闭环CAD-CAE优化中展现出优于大型模型的性能，验证了工具增强RL框架在工业设计自动化中的有效性。

Multi-constraint reward function for constraint-driven parametric design that jointly encourages feasibility, toolchain robustness, and structured output validity.
Method for casting CAD-CAE iterative design-simulation process as an interactive RL environment with defined states, actions, and rewards for LLM training.

Technique for teaching small open-source LLMs to exceed large closed-source models in constraint-driven design through RL-based training with tool orchestration.

title: OSCToM: RL-Guided Adversarial Generation for High-Order Theory of Mind
comment: 15 pages, 12 figures containing 15 images, 3 tables. Code available at https://github.com/sharminsrishty/osct
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on many language tasks, but their Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning is still uneven in complex social settings. Existing benchmarks, including ExploreToM, do not always test the recursive beliefs and information asymmetries that make these settings difficult. This paper presents OSCToM (Observer-Self Conflict Theory of Mind), an approach for modeling nested belief conflicts in LLM-based ToM tasks. The key case is one in which an observer's view of another agent conflicts with the observer's own belief state. Such cases go beyond simple perspective-taking and require recursive, multi-layered reasoning. OSCToM combines reinforcement learning (RL), an extended domain-specific language, and compositional surrogate models to generate observer-self conflicts. In our experiments, OSCToM-8B gives the best overall result among the systems tested. It improves on the reported ExploreToM results on FANToM and remains competitive on Hi-ToM and BigToM. On the information-asymmetric FANToM benchmark, OSCToM reaches 76% accuracy, compared with the 0.2% reported by ExploreToM. The data-synthesis procedure is also 6x more efficient, indicating that targeted training data can help smaller models handle advanced cognitive reasoning. The project code is available at https://github.com/sharminsrishty/osct.

AI.tldr: OSCToM是一种通过强化学习、领域特定语言和组合代理模型来生成观察者-自我信念冲突的方法，用于提升LLM在复杂社会场景中的心智理论推理能力。OSCToM-8B在FANToM基准上达到76%准确率（对比ExploreToM的0.2%），且数据合成效率提升6倍。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在复杂社会场景中的心智理论推理能力仍不均衡，现有基准（如ExploreToM）未能充分测试递归信念和信息不对称带来的挑战。
AI.method: 提出OSCToM方法，结合强化学习（RL）、扩展的领域特定语言（Domain-Specific Language）和组合代理模型（Compositional Surrogate Models），生成观察者信念与自身信念冲突的嵌套推理任务。
AI.result: OSCToM-8B在多个基准上表现最佳：FANToM信息不对称任务达76%准确率（ExploreToM仅0.2%），Hi-ToM和BigToM上保持竞争力。数据合成效率提升6倍。
AI.conclusion: 针对性训练数据可以帮助较小模型处理高级认知推理任务，OSCToM方法为LLM的心智理论推理提供了更高效的训练数据生成范式。

A domain-specific language extension for modeling nested belief hierarchies and information asymmetry in multi-agent social reasoning
A data synthesis pipeline that combines RL with compositional surrogate models to produce training data 6x more efficiently than existing methods
A benchmark approach (OSCToM) that specifically tests recursive belief conflicts where an observer's view of another agent conflicts with the observer's own belief state

title: AgentCo-op: Retrieval-Based Synthesis of Interoperable Multi-Agent Workflows
summary: Designing multi-agent workflows is especially difficult in open-ended scientific settings where tasks lack curated training sets, reliable scalar evaluation metrics, and standardized interfaces between existing tools and agents. We propose AgentCo-op, a retrieval-based synthesis framework that composes reusable skills, tools, and external agents into executable workflows through typed artifact handoffs, then applies bounded self-guided local repair to implicated components when execution evidence indicates failure. In two open-world genomics case studies, AgentCo-op composes independently developed scientific agents and external tool repositories into auditable workflows without redesigning them or running global topology search. It coordinates specialized agents for spatial transcriptomics and gene-set interpretation to enable collaborative discovery from spatial transcriptomics data, and builds a parallel workflow for cross-modality marker analysis on single-cell multiome data. AgentCo-op can also import a searched workflow as a structural prior and improve it by grounding nodes with retrieved components and applying local repair, showing that synthesis and search are complementary. On six coding, math, and question-answering benchmarks, AgentCo-op achieves the best result on four benchmarks and the best average score under a unified backbone setting, while consistently reducing per-task cost relative to multi-agent baselines. Together, these results suggest that retrieval-based synthesis can extend automated agentic workflow design beyond benchmark-optimized agent graphs to open-world workflows built from existing agents, tools, and typed artifacts.

AI.tldr: AgentCo-op是一个基于检索的合成框架，通过类型化工件传递组合可复用技能、工具和外部代理为可执行工作流，并在执行失败时对相关组件进行有界自修复，在开放科学场景中实现无需重新设计的代理协作。
AI.motivation: 开放科学场景中缺乏精心策划的训练集、可靠的标量评估指标以及标准化接口，使得设计多代理工作流极其困难。
AI.method: 提出AgentCo-op框架：(1) 通过检索合成，将可复用技能、工具和外部代理组合成工作流；(2) 使用类型化工件传递（typed artifact handoffs）来连接组件；(3) 当执行证据表明失败时，采用有界自引导局部修复（bounded self-guided local repair）对相关组件进行修复。
AI.result: 在空间转录组学和基因集解释两个开放基因组学案例中成功组合独立开发的科学代理；在6个编码、数学和问答基准上，在统一骨干设置下取得4个最佳结果和最佳平均分，同时持续降低每任务成本。
AI.conclusion: 基于检索的合成可以将自动化代理工作流设计从基准优化的代理图扩展到由现有代理、工具和类型化工件构建的开放世界工作流，且合成与搜索是互补的。

Bounded self-guided local repair mechanism that selectively fixes implicated components when execution evidence indicates failure
Method for importing a searched workflow as structural prior and improving it by grounding nodes with retrieved components and applying local repair
Typed artifact handoff system enabling standardized interfaces between independently developed scientific agents and external tool repositories

title: \ECUAS{n}: A family of metrics for principled evaluation of uncertainty-augmented systems
summary: In high-stakes automated decision-making, access to predictive uncertainty is essential for enabling users -- human or downstream systems -- to accept or reject predictions based on application-specific cost trade-offs. Such uncertainty-augmented (UA) systems -- i.e., systems that output both predictions and uncertainty scores -- are currently being assessed in the literature in a variety of ways, using separate metrics to evaluate the predictions and the uncertainty scores, setting a cost function with a fixed rejection cost or integrating over a coverage-risk curve. We argue that these evaluation approaches are inadequate for assessing overall performance of the UA system for decision making under uncertainty and propose a novel family of metrics, \ECUAS{n}, formulated as proper scoring rules for the task of interest. The parameter $n$ controls the trade-off between the cost of incorrect predictions and imperfect uncertainties depending on the needs of the use-case. We demonstrate the advantages of the \ECUAS{n} metrics both theoretically and empirically, through experiments on diverse classification and generation datasets, including a manually annotated subset of TriviaQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的评估不确定性增强（UA）系统性能的指标家族ECUAS_n，该指标基于适当的评分规则，能够统一评估预测结果和不确定性评分，克服了现有评估方法（如分离指标、固定拒绝成本或覆盖-风险曲线）的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有UA系统评估方法存在缺陷：要么单独评估预测和不确定性分数，要么使用固定拒绝成本函数，或依赖覆盖-风险曲线积分，这些方法无法全面衡量UA系统在不确定性下决策的整体性能。
AI.method: 提出ECUAS_n指标家族，将预测质量和不确定性质量的评估统一为适当的评分规则，通过参数n控制错误预测成本与不完美不确定性之间的权衡，适用于不同应用场景的需求。
AI.result: 通过理论分析和在分类、生成数据集（包括手动标注的TriviaQA子集）上的实验，证明了ECUAS_n指标相较于传统评估方法的优势。
AI.conclusion: ECUAS_n提供了一种更全面、统一的UA系统评估方法，能够更好地服务于高风险自动化决策场景中的不确定性管理。
idea_en: Innovative metric family (ECUAS_n) that unifies prediction and uncertainty score evaluation into a proper scoring rule framework for uncertainty-augmented systems
Parameter-controlled trade-off mechanism (n) for balancing cost of incorrect predictions and imperfect uncertainties in decision-making
Method for evaluating uncertainty-augmented systems as a whole rather than separately assessing prediction accuracy and uncertainty quality
idea_ch: 提出ECUAS_n指标家族，将预测质量和不确定性评分评估统一为适当的评分规则框架，克服了分离评估的缺陷

title: Open-World Evaluations for Measuring Frontier AI Capabilities
summary: Benchmark-based evaluation remains important for tracking frontier AI progress. But it can both overstate and understate deployed capability because it privileges tasks that can be precisely specified, automatically graded, easy to optimize for, and run with low budgets and short time horizons. We advocate for a complementary class of evaluations, which we term open-world evaluations: long-horizon, messy, real-world tasks assessed through small-sample qualitative analysis rather than benchmark-scale automation. In this paper we survey recent open-world evaluations, identify their strengths and limitations, and introduce CRUX (Collaborative Research for Updating AI eXpectations), a project for conducting such evaluations regularly. As a first instance, we task an AI agent with developing and publishing a simple iOS application to the Apple App Store. The agent completed the task with only a single avoidable manual intervention, suggesting that open-world evaluations can provide early warning of capabilities that may soon become widespread. We conclude with recommendations for designing and reporting open-world evals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出开放世界评估（open-world evaluations）作为传统基准测试的补充方法，通过长时间、真实场景的任务和定性分析来评估AI能力，并以AI自主开发并发布iOS应用至App Store作为案例验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统基准测试存在局限：只能评估可精确指定、自动评分、易于优化、低预算和短周期的任务，可能高估或低估AI在实际部署中的能力。
AI.method: 提出开放世界评估方法——涉及长时间跨度、真实世界中的杂乱任务，通过小样本定性分析而非大规模自动化基准进行评估。建立CRUX项目定期进行此类评估，并以AI代理开发并发布iOS应用到App Store作为首次案例。
AI.result: AI代理在仅需一次可避免的人工干预下完成了开发和发布iOS应用至App Store的完整任务。
AI.conclusion: 开放世界评估能够提供传统基准测试无法捕捉的早期预警信号，帮助预测AI能力即将普及的趋势。论文最后给出设计和报告开放世界评估的建议。

An AI agent system capable of autonomously developing and publishing a complete iOS application to the Apple App Store with minimal human intervention

A technique for identifying early warning signals of AI capabilities that may soon become widespread by using open-world evaluation tasks

title: AgentAtlas: Beyond Outcome Leaderboards for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model agents now act on codebases, browsers, operating systems, calendars, files, and tool ecosystems, but the benchmarks used to evaluate them are fragmented: each emphasizes a different unit of measurement (final task success, tool-call validity, repeated-pass consistency, trajectory safety, or attack robustness). A line of 2024-2025 work has converged on the diagnosis that a single accuracy column is no longer the right unit of comparison for deployable agents. AgentAtlas extends this line of work with four components: (i) a six-state control-decision taxonomy (Act / Ask / Refuse / Stop / Confirm / Recover); (ii) a nine-category trajectory-failure taxonomy with two orthogonal hierarchical labels (primary_error_source, impact); (iii) a taxonomy-aware vs. taxonomy-blind methodology that measures how much of a model's apparent capability comes from the supervision in the prompt; and (iv) a benchmark-coverage audit mapping fifteen agent benchmarks against six behavioral axes. To demonstrate the methodology we run a small fixed eight-model set (1,342 generated items, four frontier closed and four open-weight) under both prompt modes. Removing the explicit label menu drops every model's trajectory accuracy by 14-40 pp to a tight 0.54-0.62 floor regardless of family, and no single model wins on all three of control accuracy, trajectory diagnosis, and tool-context utility retention. We treat the synthetic run as a measurement-protocol demonstration, not a benchmark release.

AI.tldr: AgentAtlas提出了一套多维度评估框架，包含六状态控制决策分类、九类轨迹故障分类、分类感知与盲测方法论对比，以及基准覆盖审计，发现移除显式标签菜单后所有模型轨迹准确率降至0.54-0.62的狭窄区间。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体评估基准碎片化，各自侧重于任务成功率、工具调用有效性等单一指标，单一准确率已经不足以衡量可部署智能体的实际能力。
AI.method: 提出四个组件：(i)六状态控制决策分类(Act/Ask/Refuse/Stop/Confirm/Recover)；(ii)九类轨迹故障分类(含主错误源、影响两个正交层次标签)；(iii)分类感知与盲测对比方法论；(iv)15个智能体基准的六个行为轴覆盖审计。在8个模型上进行1,342项测试。
AI.result: 移除显式标签菜单后，所有模型轨迹准确率下降14-40个百分点，落入0.54-0.62的狭窄区间；没有单一模型在控制精度、轨迹诊断和工具上下文效用保留三个维度上同时胜出。
AI.conclusion: 智能体评估需要多维度的分类框架，而不是单一指标；当前模型对提示中的显式分类标签存在过度依赖。
idea_en: A six-state control-decision taxonomy (Act/Ask/Refuse/Stop/Confirm/Recover) for classifying agent behavior in codebases, browsers, OS, calendars, files, and tool ecosystems.
A nine-category trajectory-failure taxonomy with two orthogonal hierarchical labels (primary_error_source and impact) for diagnosing agent failures.
A taxonomy-aware vs. taxonomy-blind evaluation methodology that measures the extent of model capability derived from supervision in prompts.
A benchmark-coverage audit framework mapping fifteen agent benchmarks against six behavioral axes for systematic evaluation.
A method for detecting prompt-induced over-reliance on explicit label menus by comparing taxonomy-aware and taxonomy-blind performance metrics.

title: Personality Engineering with AI Agents: A New Methodology for Negotiation Research
summary: According to canonical negotiation theory, people's success in a negotiation depends on how well they balance competing demands--empathizing and asserting, demonstrating concern for other and concern for self, being soft on the people and hard on the problem. Yet people struggle to manage these tensions, so researchers have lacked the ability to rigorously test the field's prescriptions under controlled conditions. AI agents do not face the same limitations, and their precision, repertoire, consistency, and scalability enable a new class of experiments to contribute to negotiation theory. In this article, we introduce personality engineering: a methodology that uses AI agents to precisely parameterize, manipulate, and evaluate negotiator personality. We propose using the interpersonal circumplex--and its two core dimensions of warmth and dominance--as a foundational coordinate system for the field. This approach offers both a rigorous methodology for testing classic negotiation theories and a practical guide for designing the personalities of AI negotiation agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"人格工程"(Personality Engineering)方法论，利用AI代理精准参数化、操纵和评估谈判者人格，以人际环状模型(Interpersonal Circumplex)的温暖度和支配度两个核心维度作为基础坐标系，为谈判理论提供严谨的实验方法，同时为AI谈判代理的人格设计提供实践指南。
AI.motivation: 传统谈判理论认为谈判成功取决于平衡共情与坚持、关心他人与关心自我、对人温和对事强硬等竞争性需求，但人类难以管理这些张力，研究者也无法在受控条件下严格检验这些理论。AI代理不受限于人类能力，其精确性、丰富性、一致性和可扩展性为谈判理论实验提供了新可能。

AI.result: 提出了一种新的方法论框架，能够利用AI代理在受控条件下严格检验经典谈判理论，并为AI谈判代理的人格设计提供指导。
AI.conclusion: 人格工程方法论为谈判理论提供了严谨的实验手段，同时为设计AI谈判代理的人格特征提供了实践指南。

title: Mahjax: A GPU-Accelerated Mahjong Simulator for Reinforcement Learning in JAX
summary: Riichi Mahjong is a multi-player, imperfect-information game characterized by stochasticity and high-dimensional state spaces. These attributes present a unique combination of challenges that mirror complex real-world decision-making problems in reinforcement learning. While prior research has heavily relied on supervised learning from human play logs to pre-train the policy, algorithms capable of learning \textit{tabula rasa} (from scratch) offer greater potential for general applicability, as evidenced by the AlphaZero lineage. To facilitate such research, we introduce \textbf{Mahjax}, a fully vectorized Riichi Mahjong environment implemented in JAX to enable large-scale rollout parallelization on Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). We also provide a high-quality visualization tool to streamline debugging and interaction with trained agents. Experimental results demonstrate that Mahjax achieves throughputs of up to \textbf{2 million} and \textbf{1 million steps per second} on eight NVIDIA A100 GPUs under the no-red and red rules, respectively. Furthermore, we validate the environment's utility for reinforcement learning by showing that agents can be trained effectively to improve their rank against baseline policies.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍Mahjax，一个基于JAX构建的全向量化日本麻将环境，在GPU上实现大规模并行rollout，吞吐量达每秒200万步（无红规则）/100万步（红规则），支持从零开始的强化学习训练。
AI.motivation: 日本麻将具有多玩家、不完美信息、随机性和高维状态空间等复杂特征，现有研究多依赖人类对局的监督学习预训练策略，缺乏能够从零开始（tabula rasa）学习的通用算法框架。作者希望提供一个高性能、可大规模并行化的环境以推动此类研究。

AI.result: Mahjax在8块NVIDIA A100 GPU上，无红规则下达到每秒200万步吞吐量，红规则下达到每秒100万步吞吐量。通过强化学习训练，agent能有效提升对战基线策略的排名。
AI.conclusion: Mahjax为日本麻将的从零开始强化学习研究提供了高性能环境，其GPU并行化设计极具实用价值，推动了不完全信息博弈的通用算法研究。

title: From Automated to Autonomous: Hierarchical Agent-native Network Architecture (HANA)
comment: This manuscript has been accepted by IEEE Networking Letters
summary: Realizing Level 4/5 Autonomous Networks (AN) demands a shift from static automation to agent-native intelligence. Current operations, reliant on rigid scripts, lack the cognitive agency to handle off-nominal conditions. To address this, this letter proposes a hierarchical multi-agent reference architecture enabling high-level autonomy. The framework features a Dual-Driven Orchestrator that coordinates specialized Executive Agents, supported by a shared Public Memory for unified domain knowledge. A key innovation is the integration of agent self-awareness, which empowers the system to harmonize deliberative strategic governance with reflexive fault recovery. We instantiate and validate this architecture within a 5G Core environment. Case studies demonstrate that the system sustains critical throughput under congestion and reduces Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) by 86%, confirming its efficacy in unifying strategic planning with operational resilience.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向L4/L5自主网络的分层多智能体参考架构，通过双驱动编排器、公共记忆体和智能体自我意识机制，实现战略规划与运营韧性的统一，在5G核心网环境中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前网络运维依赖静态脚本，缺乏处理非标称工况的认知能力，难以实现L4/L5级别的高自主性。需要从静态自动化转向原生智能体智能。
AI.method: 提出分层多智能体参考架构：(1) 双驱动编排器(Dual-Driven Orchestrator)协调专业执行智能体；(2) 共享公共记忆体(Public Memory)统一领域知识；(3) 集成智能体自我意识(Self-Awareness)，调和深思熟虑的战略治理与反射式故障恢复。
AI.result: 在5G核心网环境中，系统在拥塞下维持了关键吞吐量，并将平均修复时间(MTTR)降低了86%。
AI.conclusion: 该架构有效统一了战略规划与运营韧性，是实现高等级自主网络的关键技术路径。

Integration of agent self-awareness mechanism that harmonizes deliberative strategic governance with reflexive fault recovery

title: COAgents: Multi-Agent Framework to Learn and Navigate Routing Problems Search Space
comment: Accepted at LION 2026, The Learning and Intelligent Optimization Conference
summary:
Although Vehicle Routing Problems (VRP) are essential to many real-world systems, they remain computationally intractable at scale due to their combinatorial complexity. Traditional heuristics rely on handcrafted rules for local improvements and occasional \textit{jumps} to escape local minima, but often struggle to generalize across diverse instances. We introduce \textbf{COAgents}, a cooperative multi-agent framework that models the search process as a graph: nodes represent solutions, and edges correspond to either local refinements or large perturbations for diversification (i.e., jumps). A \textit{Partial Search Graph} (PSG) is dynamically constructed during search, enabling COAgents to train a Node Selection Agent and a Move Selection Agent to guide intensification, and a Jump Agent to trigger well-timed explorations of new regions. Unlike end-to-end learning approaches, COAgents cleanly separates problem-agnostic search control from compact domain-specific encoding, facilitating adaptability across tasks. Extensive experiments on the CVRP and VRPTW benchmarks show that COAgents remains competitive with several learn-to-search baselines on CVRP and sets a new state of the art among learning-based methods on the more challenging VRPTW instances, reducing the gap to the best-known solutions by 14\% at $N\!=\!100$ and 44\% at $N\!=\!50$ relative to the strongest neural solver (POMO), and by 21\% and 40\% respectively relative to ALNS.
  Code is available at https://github.com/mahdims/COAgents.

AI.tldr: COAgents是一个协同多智能体框架，将VRP搜索过程建模为图结构，通过节点选择、移动选择和跳跃三个智能体协作，在CVRP和VRPTW基准测试上取得了领先性能。
AI.motivation: 传统VRP启发式算法依赖手工规则，难以跨实例泛化；端到端学习方法的搜索控制与问题编码耦合紧密，适应性有限。
AI.method: 将搜索过程建模为部分搜索图(PSG)，节点代表解，边代表局部改进或大扰动。训练三个智能体：节点选择智能体指导强化方向，移动选择智能体选择具体操作，跳跃智能体触发探索新区域。将问题无关的搜索控制与领域特定编码分离。
AI.result: 在VRPTW上达到学习型方法新最优，N=100时相对POMO缩小14%差距，N=50时缩小44%差距；相对ALNS分别缩小21%和40%差距。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索过程显式建模为图并通过多智能体分离控制与编码的策略，有效提升了VRP求解的泛化能力和性能。
idea_en: A cooperative multi-agent framework for combinatorial optimization where the search process is explicitly modeled as a Partial Search Graph (PSG) with nodes representing solutions and edges representing operations
A Node Selection Agent and Move Selection Agent that are separately trained to guide search intensification on a dynamically constructed graph
A Jump Agent that learns to trigger well-timed large perturbations to escape local minima during VRP search
Decoupled architecture separating problem-agnostic search control from compact domain-specific encoding for cross-task adaptability
Dynamic Partial Search Graph (PSG) construction during search process that enables graph-based reinforcement learning for VRP

title: Evaluating Temporal Semantic Caching and Workflow Optimization in Agentic Plan-Execute Pipelines
summary: Industrial asset operations workflows are latency-sensitive because a single user query may require coordination over sensor data, work orders, failure modes, forecasting tools, and domain-specific agents. We evaluate this problem on AssetOpsBench (AOB), an industrial agent benchmark whose plan-execute pipeline exposes repeated overhead from tool discovery, LLM planning, MCP tool execution, and final summarization. Existing LLM caching techniques such as KV-cache reuse and embedding-based semantic caching were designed for chatbot serving and break down when output validity depends on time, asset, or sensor parameters. We propose two complementary optimization layers for AOB plan-execute pipelines: a temporal semantic cache and a set of MCP workflow optimizations combining disk-backed tool-discovery caching and dependency-aware parallel step execution. MCP workflow optimizations corresponded to a 1.67x speedup and reduced median end-to-end latency by about 40.0% while the temporal-cache benchmark achieved a median of 30.6x speedup on cache hits. Beyond the speedup, our results expose a concrete failure mode of pure semantic caching for parameter-rich industrial queries, providing a critical analysis of how caching choices interact with evaluation correctness in MCP-backed agent benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对工业资产运维场景中延迟敏感的工作流问题，提出两种缓存优化方法：时间语义缓存和MCP工作流优化（磁盘备份工具发现缓存+依赖感知并行执行），在AssetOpsBench基准测试中分别实现30.6x和1.67x加速，并揭示了纯语义缓存在参数丰富的工业查询中的失效模式。
AI.motivation: 工业资产运维工作流对延迟高度敏感，单个用户查询需协调传感器数据、工单、故障模式、预测工具和领域智能体。现有LLM缓存技术（如KV缓存复用、基于嵌入的语义缓存）针对聊天服务设计，在输出有效性依赖时间、资产或传感器参数时失效。
AI.method: 提出两种互补优化层：1) 时间语义缓存（temporal semantic cache）；2) MCP工作流优化，包括磁盘备份工具发现缓存（disk-backed tool-discovery caching）和依赖感知并行步骤执行（dependency-aware parallel step execution）。在AssetOpsBench基准测试的plan-execute流水线上评估。
AI.result: MCP工作流优化实现1.67倍加速，中位端到端延迟降低约40%；时间语义缓存在缓存命中时实现中位30.6倍加速。同时揭示了纯语义缓存在参数丰富的工业查询中的具体失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 两种优化方法有效降低工业资产运维工作流延迟，时间语义缓存加速效果显著。同时指出缓存选择如何与MCP支持的智能体基准测试的正确性评估交互，为工业领域缓存设计提供关键分析。
idea_en: Temporal semantic cache for industrial agent workflows: a caching mechanism that considers temporal validity (time, asset, sensor parameters) rather than pure semantic similarity, tailored for plan-execute pipelines in asset operations.
Disk-backed tool-discovery caching for MCP (Model Context Protocol) workflows: persistently caching tool discovery results to avoid repeated overhead in industrial agent pipelines.
Dependency-aware parallel step execution in MCP workflows: executing independent steps in parallel while respecting dependency constraints, reducing end-to-end latency in plan-execute pipelines.
Hybrid caching architecture combining temporal semantic cache and MCP workflow optimizations for latency-sensitive industrial asset operations.

title: Declarative Data Services: Structured Agentic Discovery for Composing Data Systems
comment: Shanshan Ye and Duo Lu contributed equally to this work
summary: Agentic discovery has shown that LLM-driven search can find novel algorithms, designs, and code under benchmark conditions. Translating the paradigm to multi-system data backends surfaces a harder problem: the search space is heterogeneous, the verifier is whether a deployed stack actually runs, and composition knowledge is unevenly captured in pretraining. Unbounded agentic discovery, a coding agent iterating on failure-log feedback, fails to converge consistently on a working stack even when iteration and explicit composition knowledge are added. We propose Declarative Data Services (DDS), an architecture for structured agentic discovery of data-system compositions from declarative user intent. The framework owns four typed contracts at successive layers (intent, operator DAG, per-system skills, runtime attribution) that decompose the global search into bounded sub-searches; sub-agents search each typed space, while the framework provides the channels by which knowledge flows forward as inline skill citations and errors route backward as typed signals. As a proof of life on a trading-backend workload, DDS converges where unbounded discovery does not; runtime failures become skill patches that the next deployment cites inline. We position this as an early prototype reporting lessons from real-world data-system composition.

AI.tldr: 提出声明式数据服务(DDS)架构，通过分层类型契约和有界子搜索，使LLM驱动的智能体能够在异构数据系统组合中发现可行部署方案，解决了无界智能体发现无法收敛的问题。
AI.motivation: 将智能体发现范式从单一基准测试扩展到多系统数据后端时，搜索空间异构、验证器复杂、组合知识分布不均，导致无界智能体发现无法一致收敛到可行栈。
AI.method: 提出DDS架构，包含四个分层类型契约（意图层、算子DAG层、系统技能层、运行时归因层），将全局搜索分解为有界子搜索；子智能体在各类型空间中搜索，框架提供知识前向流动（内联技能引用）和错误反向路由（类型化信号）的通道。
AI.result: 在交易后端工作负载上，DDS在无界发现无法收敛的场景下成功收敛；运行时失败转化为技能补丁，被后续部署内联引用。
AI.conclusion: DDS作为早期原型，展示了结构化智能体发现范式在真实世界数据系统组合中的可行性，从实际部署经验中总结教训。

Failure-to-skill-patch mechanism where runtime failures are automatically transformed into inline skill citations for subsequent deployments
Typed signal routing system that enables forward knowledge flow (skill citations) and backward error routing (typed signals) across sub-agents
Bounded sub-agent search architecture that ensures convergence where unbounded agentic discovery fails

title: VBFDD-Agent for Electric Vehicle Battery Fault Detection and Diagnosis: Descriptive Text Modeling of Battery Digital Signals
summary:
With the rapid proliferation of electric vehicles, the safety and reliability of lithium-ion batteries have become critical concerns. Effective anomaly detection is essential for ensuring safe battery operation. However, as battery systems and operating scenarios become increasingly complex, battery fault diagnosis and maintenance require stronger cross-domain adaptability and human-AI collaboration. Traditional fault detection and diagnosis methods are usually designed for specific scenarios and predefined workflows, making them less effective in complex real-world applications.
  To address the scarcity of open-source battery fault report corpora and the lack of unified maintenance knowledge representation, this study proposes a descriptive text modeling approach for battery signal reports. Monitoring signals, statistical features, anomaly records, and state assessment results are transformed into structured and readable natural language descriptions, forming a language corpus for battery health diagnosis and maintenance.
  Based on this corpus, we propose VBFDD-Agent, a vehicle battery fault detection and diagnosis agent for automotive-grade battery systems. VBFDD-Agent integrates descriptive battery-state texts, historical case retrieval, local maintenance manuals, and large language model reasoning to generate structured diagnostic results and maintenance recommendations. Experiments show that the proposed framework can accurately perform anomaly monitoring based on descriptive textual representations and provide flexible, efficient, and actionable maintenance suggestions. Expert evaluation further confirms the practical value of the generated recommendations. Overall, VBFDD-Agent extends traditional battery diagnosis from label prediction to interpretable and maintenance-oriented decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文针对锂电池故障诊断领域缺乏开源语料和统一知识表示的问题，提出将电池监测信号转化为结构化自然语言描述，并构建了VBFDD-Agent智能体系统，集成大语言模型推理、历史案例检索和本地维修手册，实现可解释的故障检测与维护建议生成。

title: Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance for Flow Models under Compositional Rewards
comment: Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Inference-time guided sampling steers state-of-the-art diffusion and flow models without fine-tuning by interpreting the generation process as a controllable trajectory. This provides a simple and flexible way to inject external constraints (e.g., cost functions or pre-trained verifiers) for controlled generation. However, existing methods often fail when composing multiple constraints simultaneously, which leads to deviations from the true data manifold. In this work, we identify root causes of this off-manifold drift and find that the approximation error scales severely with gradient misalignment. Building on these findings, we propose Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance ($g^\text{car}$), a lightweight and learnable method, which actively rectifies off-manifold drift by dynamically detecting and resolving gradient conflicts. We validate $g^\text{car}$ across diverse domains, ranging from synthetic datasets and image editing to generative decision-making for planning and control. Our results demonstrate that $g^\text{car}$ effectively rectifies off-manifold drift, surpassing baselines in generation fidelity while using light compute. Code is available at https://github.com/yuxuehui/CAR-guidance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance (g^car)，一种轻量级可学习方法，通过动态检测和解决梯度冲突来修正扩散/流模型在多约束组合引导下的离流形漂移问题，在图像编辑、规划控制等任务中提升生成保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时引导采样方法在组合多个外部约束（如代价函数或预训练验证器）时，常导致生成结果偏离真实数据流形（off-manifold drift），且梯度不对齐会严重放大近似误差。现有方法缺乏对此问题的系统分析和有效修正手段。
AI.method: 1) 识别离流形漂移的根本原因：多约束梯度不对齐导致的近似误差累积。2) 提出Conflict-Aware Additive Guidance (g^car)，一种轻量级可学习模块，在推理时动态检测多约束梯度之间的冲突，并主动修正漂移方向，使生成轨迹保持在真实数据流形附近。
AI.result: 在合成数据集、图像编辑以及生成式决策规划与控制等多个领域验证，g^car有效修正离流形漂移，在生成保真度上超越基线方法，且计算开销低。
AI.conclusion: 梯度冲突是导致多约束组合引导下离流形漂移的关键因素，g^car通过动态检测和解决冲突，实现了高效、保真的可控生成，具有良好的通用性和实用性。
idea_en: A conflict-aware additive guidance method that dynamically detects gradient conflicts among multiple external constraints during inference-time sampling, and actively rectifies off-manifold drift in diffusion/flow models.

A lightweight learnable module for inference-time guided sampling that resolves gradient misalignment issues when composing multiple constraints, without requiring fine-tuning of the base generative model.

A training-free or light-training approach for multi-constraint controlled generation that monitors gradient directions in real-time and adjusts the sampling trajectory to stay on the true data manifold.

A system for generative decision-making in planning and control tasks that uses conflict-aware additive guidance to combine multiple cost functions or verifiers as constraints during diffusion-based trajectory generation.

title: Interaction Locality in Hierarchical Recursive Reasoning
summary: Spatial reasoning requires both location-bound computation and location-invariant structure: agents must make local moves while preserving route, object, or constraint-level plans. We propose interaction locality, a task-geometry-aware framework for measuring whether information flow stays within nearby cells or semantic segments, or crosses them. We instantiate the framework with sparse-autoencoder feature ablations and finite-noise activation patching, with structural Jacobian and attention checks reported in the appendix, and apply it to HRM and TRM, two compact hierarchical and recursive reasoning models, on Maze-Hard, Sudoku Extreme, and ARC-AGI. Across these models, activation patching gives the clearest architectural fingerprint: high-level recurrent states tend to write information within nearby cells or same-segment units, while repeated recursive updates accumulate these local writes into broader solution structure. This pattern holds across maze paths, Sudoku constraints, and ARC-AGI object neighborhoods, with the strongest concentration in TRM. To test whether interaction locality extends beyond toy-yet-challenging grid benchmarks, we also apply it to MTU3D, a large-scale embodied 3D scene-grounding model. In this MTU3D setting, causal spatial locality appears primarily at the transition where visual scene features are handed to the downstream grounding module, rather than uniformly throughout the visual encoder. This contrast suggests that the local-to-global handoff observed in HRM and TRM is tied to explicit recursive reasoning dynamics, while embodied 3D models may concentrate causal spatial structure at module boundaries. Interaction locality turns the intuitive local-execution/global-planning story into a reproducible measurement framework for recursive and embodied spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“交互局部性”（interaction locality）框架，用于测量空间推理中信息流是否在局部或语义段内流动，并通过消融实验和激活修补技术，在HRM、TRM等递归推理模型及MTU3D具身3D模型中验证了该框架的有效性。
AI.motivation: 空间推理需要同时支持位置绑定计算和位置不变结构，但缺乏统一的可重复测量框架来量化信息在局部与全局之间的流动模式。
AI.method: 提出交互局部性框架，使用稀疏自编码器特征消融和有限噪声激活修补技术，结合结构雅可比和注意力检查，应用于HRM、TRM（层次/递归推理模型）以及MTU3D（具身3D场景接地模型）。
AI.result: 在HRM和TRM中，高层递归状态倾向于将信息写入附近单元或同段单元，递归更新逐步积累局部写入形成全局解结构；在MTU3D中，因果空间局部性主要出现在视觉特征传递给下游接地模块的边界处。
AI.conclusion: 交互局部性将直观的“局部执行/全局规划”故事转化为可重复测量的框架，揭示了递归推理与具身3D模型中不同的空间因果结构模式。

A method for measuring whether neural network activations write information within nearby cells or same-segment units via structural Jacobian and attention checks
A technique to detect local-to-global handoff in recursive reasoning models by accumulating local writes from repeated recursive updates

title: Conditional Equivalence of DPO and RLHF: Implicit Assumption, Failure Modes, and Provable Alignment
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has emerged as a popular alternative to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), offering theoretical equivalence with simpler implementation. We prove this equivalence is conditional rather than universal, depending on an implicit assumption frequently violated in practice: the RLHF-optimal policy must prefer human-preferred responses. When this assumption fails, DPO optimizes relative advantage over the reference policy rather than absolute alignment with human preferences, leading to pathological convergence where policies decrease DPO loss while preferring dispreferred responses. We characterize when this assumption is violated, show the existence of an undesirable solution space, and prove that DPO and RLHF optimize fundamentally different objectives in such cases. To address this, we introduce Constrained Preference Optimization (CPO), augmenting RLHF with constraints for provable alignment. We further provide a geometric interpretation through soft margin ranking, revealing that DPO implements margin ranking with potentially negative targets. Our theoretical analysis establishes when DPOs' guarantees hold and provides solutions preserving simplicity with provable alignment. Comprehensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that CPO achieves state-of-the-art performance. Code is available at: https://github.com/visitworld123/CPO.

AI.tldr: 本文发现DPO与RLHF的理论等价性是有条件的，当条件不满足时DPO会收敛到次优解，并提出CPO方法解决该问题。
AI.motivation: 揭示DPO与RLHF理论等价性成立的隐含假设，指出该假设在实践中常被违反，导致DPO优化目标偏离真实的对齐目标。
AI.method: 提出Constrained Preference Optimization (CPO)，通过引入约束来增强RLHF，实现可证明的对齐；同时通过软间隔排序视角解释DPO的缺陷。
AI.result: 在标准基准测试上CPO达到了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: DPO在条件不满足时优化的是相对优势而非绝对对齐，CPO通过约束解决了这一问题，兼顾了简洁性和可证明的对齐保证。
idea_en: Constrained Preference Optimization (CPO): A method that augments RLHF with explicit constraints to ensure provable alignment between policy optimization and human preferences, preventing pathological convergence where policies decrease loss while preferring dispreferred responses.

Condition-aware preference optimization framework: A system that detects when the implicit assumption of DPO-RLHF equivalence is violated (i.e., RLHF-optimal policy does not prefer human-preferred responses) and switches between optimization strategies accordingly.

Soft margin ranking interpretation for DPO: A geometric analysis framework that reveals DPO implements margin ranking with potentially negative targets, enabling diagnosis of training instability and providing guidance for hyperparameter tuning.

Provable alignment guarantee mechanism: A constraint-based optimization approach that mathematically ensures the optimized policy's preferences are aligned with human preferences rather than just relative advantages over a reference policy.
idea_ch: 约束偏好优化(CPO)：一种通过显式约束增强RLHF的方法，确保策略优化与人类偏好之间的可证明对齐，防止策略在降低损失的同时偏好人类不喜欢回答的病态收敛。
条件感知偏好优化框架：一种检测DPO与RLHF等价性隐含假设何时被违反(即RLHF最优策略不偏好人类偏好的回答)的系统，并据此在优化策略之间切换。
DPO软间隔排序解释框架：一种几何分析框架，揭示DPO实现了可能带有负目标的间隔排序，可用于诊断训练不稳定性并为超参数调优提供指导。
可证明对齐保证机制：一种基于约束的优化方法，从数学上确保优化后的策略偏好与人类偏好对齐，而不仅仅是相对于参考策略的相对优势。

title: PlanningBench: Generating Scalable and Verifiable Planning Data for Evaluating and Training Large Language Models
summary: Planning is a fundamental capability for large language models (LLMs) because such complex tasks require models to coordinate goals, constraints, resources, and long-term consequences into executable and verifiable solutions. Existing planning benchmarks, however, usually treat planning data as fixed collections of instances rather than controllable generation targets. This limits scenario coverage, ties difficulty to surface-level proxies rather than structural sources, and offers limited support for scalable generation, automatic verification, or planning-oriented training. We introduce PlanningBench, a framework for generating scalable, diverse, and verifiable planning data for both evaluation and training. PlanningBench starts from real planning scenarios and abstracts practical workflows into a structured taxonomy of more than 30 task types, subtasks, constraint families, and difficulty factors. Guided by this taxonomy, a constraint-driven synthesis pipeline instantiates self-contained planning problems with adaptive difficulty control, quality filtering, and instance-level verification checklists. This shifts planning data construction from fixed benchmark collection to controllable generation while preserving realistic task grounding. We use PlanningBench to evaluate open-source and closed-source frontier LLMs, and find that current models still struggle to produce complete solutions under coupled constraints. Beyond evaluation, reinforcement learning on verified PlanningBench data improves performance on unseen planning benchmarks and broader instruction-following tasks. Further analysis suggests that determinate or well-specified optimal solutions provide clearer reward signals and more stable training dynamics. Overall, PlanningBench provides a controllable source of planning data for diagnosing and improving generalizable planning abilities in LLMs.

AI.tldr: PlanningBench是一个用于生成可扩展、多样化且可验证的规划数据的框架，通过约束驱动的合成流程和结构化分类法，将规划数据从固定基准集合转变为可控生成，并证明强化学习在该数据上训练能提升LLM在未见规划任务和指令遵循任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有规划基准将规划数据视为固定实例集合，缺乏可控生成能力，导致场景覆盖有限、难度仅依赖表面代理指标、难以支持规模化生成、自动验证及规划导向训练。
AI.method: 从真实规划场景出发，将实践工作流抽象为包含30多种任务类型、子任务、约束族和难度因素的结构化分类法；基于该分类法构建约束驱动合成流程，实现自包含规划问题的实例化、自适应难度控制、质量过滤和实例级验证清单。
AI.result: 评估显示当前前沿LLM在耦合约束下仍难以生成完整解决方案；在验证过的PlanningBench数据上进行强化学习，能提升模型在未见规划基准和更广泛指令遵循任务上的性能。
AI.conclusion: PlanningBench为诊断和提升LLM的通用规划能力提供了可控的规划数据来源，且确定性或良好指定的最优解能提供更清晰的奖励信号和更稳定的训练动态。
idea_en: A constraint-driven synthesis pipeline for generating self-contained planning problems with adaptive difficulty control, quality filtering, and instance-level verification checklists.
A structured taxonomy of more than 30 task types, subtasks, constraint families, and difficulty factors abstracted from real-world planning scenarios.
A method using verified planning data as reinforcement learning training source to improve LLM performance on unseen planning benchmarks and broader instruction-following tasks.
An adaptive difficulty control mechanism that dynamically adjusts planning problem complexity based on structural constraints rather than surface-level proxies.
idea_ch: 基于约束驱动的合成流水线，用于生成自包含的规划问题，具备自适应难度控制、质量过滤和实例级验证清单功能。

title: Governance by Construction for Generalist Agents
summary: Enterprise agents are increasingly expected to operate autonomously across tools and interfaces, yet production deployments require governance by construction. Systems must specify which actions are allowed, when human oversight is required, and what information may be exposed, without rebuilding the agent for each domain. This demo presents CUGA's policy system, a modular policy-as-code layer that composes with a generalist LLM agent to deliver predictable, auditable, and compliance-aware behavior in compound workflows without model fine-tuning. We present a runtime governance architecture that enforces policy interventions at every critical stage of execution. Rather than passively constraining behavior, policies intercept the agent at five structural checkpoints: upstream of planning (Intent Guard), within the system prompt to steer reasoning (Playbook), at the tool-call boundary to enforce proper usage (Tool Guide), outside the reasoning loop as a Human-in-the-Loop gate for high-risk actions (Tool Approvals), and at the output stage to filter and structure the final response (Output Formatter). Together, these stages embed governance continuously across the agent's execution pipeline rather than treating it as an afterthought. Using a healthcare scenario and a multi-layered enforcement intervention, the demo shows dynamic playbook injection for structured tool-sequence enforcement, intent guards that block malicious or accidental harmful requests, and human-in-the-loop tool approval checkpoints for potentially destructive actions. The artifact illustrates how typed governance primitives enable faster, safer deployment of enterprise agentic systems while improving policy adherence and execution consistency.

title: For How Long Should We Be Punching? Learning Action Duration in Fighting Games
summary: Fighting games such as Street Fighter II present unique challenges to reinforcement learning (RL) agents due to their fast-paced, real-time nature. In most RL frameworks, agents are hard-coded to make decisions at a fixed interval, typically every frame or every N frames. Although this design ensures timely responses, it restricts the agent's ability to adjust its reaction timing. Acting every frame grants frame-perfect reflexes, which are unrealistic compared to human players, whereas longer fixed intervals reduce computational cost but hinder responsiveness. We consider an alternative decision-making framework in which the agent learns not only what action to take but also for how long to execute it. By jointly predicting both action and duration, the agent can dynamically adapt its responsiveness to different situations in the game. We implement this method using the open-source FightLadder environment with agents trained against scripted built-in bots, systematically testing different frame skip configurations to analyze their influence on performance, responsiveness, and learned behavior. Experiments show that learned timing can match the performance of well-chosen fixed frame skips and encourages repeatable action patterns, but does not ensure robustness on its own. In most cases, we see agents performing best with consistently high frame skip values (i.e., low responsiveness). This strategy makes it easier to learn exploitative strategies where the same action is repeated over and over, which the scripted bots appear to be susceptible to.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究格斗游戏中强化学习代理的决策时机问题，提出了一种让代理同时学习动作和执行时长的框架，以动态调整响应速度。
AI.motivation: 传统RL框架中代理以固定间隔（每帧或每N帧）做决策，要么帧级完美反应不现实，要么固定长间隔降低响应性。需要一种能动态调整反应时机的决策框架。
AI.method: 提出一种替代决策框架，代理不仅学习采取什么动作，还学习每个动作执行多长时间，通过联合预测动作和持续时间来动态适应游戏中的不同情况。在FightLadder环境中进行实验，对比不同帧跳跃配置。
AI.result: 学习到的时序能与精心选择的固定帧跳跃性能相当，并鼓励可重复的动作模式，但本身不能保证鲁棒性。代理在高帧跳跃值（低响应性）下表现最佳，易形成重复动作的剥削性策略。
AI.conclusion: 学习的动作时长可以替代固定帧跳跃策略，但需配合其他机制增强鲁棒性，避免过度依赖重复动作的剥削策略。
idea_en: A reinforcement learning method that jointly predicts action type and action duration, allowing the agent to dynamically adjust decision timing in real-time games.
A dynamic frame skip mechanism in fighting games where the agent learns to vary the execution length of each action based on game state, rather than using fixed intervals.
An adaptive responsiveness control system for RL agents in fast-paced games that enables the agent to balance between reaction speed and computational cost through learned action durations.
idea_ch: 一种联合预测动作类型和动作持续时间的强化学习方法，使代理能够动态调整实时游戏中的决策时机。
一种格斗游戏中的动态帧跳跃机制，代理根据游戏状态学习每个动作的执行时长，而非使用固定间隔。
一种针对快节奏游戏中RL代理的自适应响应性控制系统，通过学习的动作时长平衡反应速度与计算成本。

title: Playing Devil's Advocate: Off-the-Shelf Persona Vectors Rival Targeted Steering for Sycophancy
summary: We study the effect of different persona on \textbf{sycophancy}: model's agreement with users even when the user is incorrect. The standard mitigation, Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), derives a steering direction from labelled pairs of sycophantic and honest responses. This study evaluates whether off-the-shelf persona steering vectors, originally developed for general role-playing and not trained on sycophancy data, can serve as an alternative. In two instruction-tuned models, steering toward personas characterised by doubt or scrutiny reduces sycophancy to approximately $68\%$ and $98\%$ of CAA's effect, and, unlike CAA, maintains accuracy when the user is correct. The effect is also asymmetric: steering toward agreeable personas does not produce a mirror increase in sycophancy. Geometrically, the persona vector is largely independent of the direction of sycophancy in activation space. Collectively, these findings suggest that sycophancy is better understood as a persona-level property rather than a single steerable direction. We release our code here: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Sycophancy-Steering-9DF0/.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不同人格特征对模型谄媚行为（sycophancy）的影响，发现使用现成的"怀疑"或"审慎"人格导向向量可替代专用的对比激活添加（CAA）方法来减少谄媚，且不会牺牲用户正确时的准确性。研究表明谄媚更像是一种人格层面的属性，而非单一可引导的方向。
AI.motivation: 探索是否可以使用现成的、非专门针对谄媚数据训练的人格导向向量来替代CAA方法减少模型谄媚行为，并理解谄媚行为在激活空间中的本质属性。
AI.method: 在两个指令微调模型上，使用现成的"怀疑"和"审慎"人格导向向量进行干预，与CAA方法对比效果，并在用户正确和错误两种场景下分别评估准确率变化，同时分析人格向量与谄媚方向在几何空间中的关系。
AI.result: 怀疑和审慎人格导向可将谄媚降低至CAA效果的约68%和98%，且在用户正确时保持准确率（CAA会降低准确率）。人格导向与谄媚方向在激活空间中基本独立，且效果不对称——引导至" agreeable"人格不会镜像地增加谄媚。
AI.conclusion: 谄媚行为更适合理解为一种人格层面的属性，而非单一的、可独立调控的方向。现成的人格导向向量可作为减少谄媚的有效替代方案。
idea_en: A method for reducing sycophancy in language models by applying pre-computed persona steering vectors (e.g., skepticism or scrutiny) without requiring sycophancy-specific training data.
An asymmetric activation steering technique that selectively reduces sycophancy when user is incorrect while maintaining accuracy when user is correct, using off-the-shelf persona vectors.
A geometric analysis framework for characterizing sycophancy as a persona-level property in activation space, revealing orthogonality between persona vectors and sycophancy directions.

A sycophancy mitigation system that leverages persona steering vectors as a drop-in replacement for Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA), achieving comparable or superior performance in accuracy preservation.
idea_ch: 一种利用现有人格导向向量（如怀疑、审慎人格）减少语言模型谄媚行为的方法，无需针对谄媚数据专门训练。
一种非对称激活引导技术，在用户错误时选择性减少模型谄媚，同时在用户正确时保持模型准确性，使用现成的通用人格向量。
一种将谄媚行为表征为人格层面属性的几何分析框架，揭示了激活空间中人格向量与谄媚方向之间的正交性关系。

title: AutoRPA: Efficient GUI Automation through LLM-Driven Code Synthesis from Interactions
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) based agents have demonstrated proficiency in multi-step interactions with graphical user interfaces (GUIs). While most research focuses on improving single-task performance, practical scenarios often involve repetitive GUI tasks for which invoking LLM reasoning repeatedly, i.e., the ReAct paradigm, is inefficient. Prior to LLMs, traditional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) offers runtime efficiency but demands significant manual effort to develop and maintain. To bridge this gap, we propose AutoRPA, a framework that automatically distills the decision logic of ReAct-style agents into robust RPA functions. AutoRPA introduces two core innovations: (1) A translator-builder pipeline, where a translator agent converts hard-coded ReAct actions into soft-coded procedures, and a builder agent synthesizes robust RPA functions via retrieval-augmented generation over multiple trajectories; (2) A hybrid repair strategy during code verification, combining RPA execution with ReAct-based fallback for iterative refinement. Experiments across multiple GUI environments demonstrate that RPA functions generated by AutoRPA successfully solve similar tasks while reducing token usage by 82% to 96%, significantly improving runtime efficiency and reusability.

AI.tldr: AutoRPA是一个自动将ReAct风格的LLM智能体决策逻辑蒸馏为鲁棒RPA函数的框架，通过翻译器-构建器流水线和混合修复策略，在GUI任务中实现82%-96%的token节省，兼顾运行时效率与可复用性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的GUI智能体虽能处理多步交互，但ReAct范式在重复性任务中反复调用LLM推理效率低下；传统RPA虽运行时高效，但需要大量人工开发维护。AutoRPA旨在自动弥合两者差距，兼顾智能与效率。
AI.method: (1) 翻译器-构建器流水线：翻译器将硬编码的ReAct动作转换为软编码过程，构建器通过检索增强生成（RAG）从多条轨迹中合成鲁棒RPA函数；(2) 混合修复策略：在代码验证阶段，结合RPA执行与ReAct回退进行迭代精炼。
AI.result: 在多个GUI环境中，AutoRPA生成的RPA函数能成功解决相似任务，同时减少82%至96%的token使用量，显著提升运行时效率和可复用性。
AI.conclusion: AutoRPA成功实现了将LLM智能体的决策逻辑自动转化为高效、可复用的RPA函数，在保持任务完成能力的同时大幅降低计算成本，为重复GUI任务的自动化提供了实用方案。
idea_en: Translator-builder pipeline for converting hard-coded ReAct actions into soft-coded procedures and synthesizing robust RPA functions via retrieval-augmented generation from multiple trajectories
Hybrid repair strategy combining RPA execution with ReAct-based fallback for iterative code verification and refinement
idea_ch: 翻译器-构建器流水线：将硬编码的ReAct动作转换为软编码过程，并通过基于检索增强生成（RAG）从多条执行轨迹中合成鲁棒RPA函数的方法

title: ScenePilot: Controllable Boundary-Driven Critical Scenario Generation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Safety-critical scenarios are central to evaluating autonomous driving systems, yet their rarity in naturalistic logs makes simulation-based stress testing indispensable. Most scenario generation methods treat surrounding agents as adversaries, but they either (i) induce failures without explicitly modeling vehicle-road physical limits, yielding visually extreme yet physically unsolvable crashes, or (ii) enforce physical feasibility or policy feasibility in isolation, which can over-focus on aggressive maneuvers or remain tied to a controller-dependent capability boundary. We propose ScenePilot, a feasibility-guided, boundary-driven framework that targets the boundary band: scenarios that are physically solvable in principle yet still cause the deployed autonomy stack to fail. We formulate generation as constrained multi-objective reinforcement learning, combining an RSS-derived physical-feasibility score $σ$ with an online-learned AV-risk predictor $Φ$, and introduce step-level feasibility-aware shielding to keep exploration near the feasibility boundary while avoiding infeasible artifacts. Experiments on SafeBench with multiple planners show that ScenePilot yields substantially higher collision rates (+6.2 percentage points) while preserving physical validity, and that adversarial fine-tuning on these boundary-band scenarios consistently reduces downstream crash rates. The code is available at https://github.com/QiyuRuan/ScenePilot.

AI.tldr: ScenePilot是一个以可行性为导向、边界驱动的自动驾驶场景生成框架，通过约束多目标强化学习生成物理上可解但导致自动驾驶系统失败的边界带场景，有效提升了碰撞率同时保持物理有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶安全关键场景生成方法存在两类问题：要么忽略车辆-道路物理极限，生成视觉极端但物理上不可解的碰撞场景；要么孤立地强制执行物理可行性或策略可行性，导致过度关注激进操作或受限于控制器依赖的能力边界。需要一种方法生成物理上可解但实际导致自动驾驶系统失败的边界场景。
AI.method: 将场景生成问题建模为约束多目标强化学习，结合RSS推导的物理可行性评分σ和在线学习的AV风险预测器Φ，引入步骤级可行性感知屏蔽机制，使探索保持在可行性边界附近同时避免生成不可行的伪影。
AI.result: 在SafeBench上多个规划器的实验表明，ScenePilot在保持物理有效性的同时，碰撞率提高6.2个百分点；在这些边界带场景上进行对抗性微调能持续降低下游碰撞率。
AI.conclusion: ScenePilot成功实现了物理可行性与挑战性的平衡，生成的边界带场景对评估和提升自动驾驶系统安全性具有重要价值。
idea_en: A feasibility-guided scenario generation method that combines RSS-derived physical-feasibility score with online-learned AV-risk predictor in a constrained multi-objective reinforcement learning framework
A step-level feasibility-aware shielding mechanism that keeps exploration near the feasibility boundary while avoiding physically infeasible artifacts
A boundary-band scenario concept targeting physically solvable yet autonomy-stack-failing scenarios for adversarial stress testing
Adversarial fine-tuning on boundary-band scenarios to consistently reduce downstream crash rates

一种步骤级可行性感知屏蔽机制，使探索保持在可行性边界附近，同时避免物理不可行的伪影生成

title: Insights Generator: Systematic Corpus-Level Trace Diagnostics for LLM Agents
summary: Diagnosing failures in LLM agents remains largely manual. Practitioners inspect a small subset of execution traces, form ad-hoc hypotheses, and iterate. This process misses patterns that only emerge across trace populations and does not scale to production corpora where individual traces span tens of thousands of tokens. We formalize the problem of corpus-level trace diagnostics. Given a corpus of execution traces, the goal is to produce grounded natural-language insights that characterize systematic behavioral patterns across trace groups, each linked to supporting evidence. We present the Insights Generator (IG), a multi-agent system that answers diagnostic questions by proposing and testing hypotheses across the trace corpus to produce an evidence-backed insights report. We evaluate IG across qualitative and objective dimensions, spanning rubric-based report assessment and downstream performance improvements achieved by implementing IG insights. Human experts using IG reports improve scaffold performance by 30.4pp over the unmodified baseline scaffold, and coding agents leveraging IG-derived insights show consistent and stable gains. Across benchmarks, IG's scout-investigator architecture produces findings comparable in detection coverage to competing approaches, while domain experts rated IG reports as leading depth and evidence quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Insights Generator (IG)，一种多智能体系统，用于自动化LLM代理执行轨迹的语料级诊断，通过假设验证生成有证据支持的洞察报告，提升代理性能达30.4个百分点。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM代理的故障诊断主要依赖手动检查少量执行轨迹，形成临时假设并迭代，这种方式无法发现跨轨迹群体的系统模式，也无法扩展到生产级语料库（单个轨迹可能包含数万个token）。
AI.method: 提出Insights Generator (IG)，采用侦察-调查员（scout-investigator）多智能体架构：侦察智能体扫描轨迹语料库提出假设，调查员智能体通过系统性测试验证假设，最终生成有证据支持的洞察报告。
AI.result: 使用IG报告的人类专家将代理性能提升30.4个百分点；编码代理利用IG洞察获得一致稳定的收益；IG的检测覆盖率与竞品方法相当，而领域专家评价IG报告在深度和证据质量上领先。
AI.conclusion: IG证明了自动化语料级轨迹诊断的可行性，其多智能体架构能有效发现跨轨迹的系统性模式，生成基于证据的可操作洞察，显著提升LLM代理性能。
idea_en: Multi-agent Scout-Investigator architecture for automated corpus-level trace diagnostics in LLM agents
Method for generating evidence-backed natural-language insights reports from execution trace corpora through hypothesis testing
Systematic approach to identifying cross-trace behavioral patterns that emerge only across population-scale trace analysis
idea_ch: 基于侦察-调查员多智能体架构的LLM代理语料级轨迹自动诊断方法
通过假设验证从执行轨迹语料库生成有证据支持的自然语言洞察报告的技术

title: Towards Resilient and Autonomous Networks: A BlueSky Vision on AI-Native 6G
summary: The proliferation of emerging applications, such as autonomous driving and immersive experiences, demands cellular networks that are not only faster, but fundamentally more resilient and autonomous. This paper presents a BlueSky vision on how Artificial Intelligence will be natively integrated into 6G, shifting the paradigm from \underline{Network for AI} to \underline{AI for Network}. We envision that, unlike 5G's reliance on scattered, ad-hoc models each trained for a single task, native AI in the 6G era will be anchored by a foundation model and and orchestrated via collaborative multi-agent systems, framing network management as a unified, multi-modal, multi-task optimization problem. Built on this vision, we outline two transformative directions. The first focuses on developing a 6G foundation model as a unified backbone, with task-specific knowledge distilled into compact models suited for diverse edge deployments. The second advances multi-agent systems designed to autonomously diagnose, maintain, and recover networks with minimal human intervention. These directions chart a roadmap for 6G to evolve into an intelligent, self-sustaining communication infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了6G原生AI的蓝景愿景，从"面向AI的网络"转向"AI赋能网络"，以基础模型和多智能体系统为核心，构建自智、自愈的通信基础设施。
AI.motivation: 新兴应用（如自动驾驶、沉浸式体验）对蜂窝网络提出了更高要求，不仅要更快，还要更具韧性和自主性。5G依赖零散、单任务的AI模型，难以满足6G的复杂需求。
AI.method: 提出两大方向：1) 6G基础模型作为统一骨干网络，将任务特定知识蒸馏为适配边缘部署的轻量模型；2) 多智能体系统实现网络自主诊断、维护与恢复。
AI.result: 描绘了6G从"AI辅助网络"向"AI原生网络"演进的路线图，实现统一多模态多任务优化与最小人工干预的自主网络管理。
AI.conclusion: 6G应演进为智能、自维持的通信基础设施，通过基础模型与多智能体协作实现原生AI集成。
idea_en: A 6G foundation model serving as a unified backbone network, with task-specific knowledge distilled into compact models for diverse edge deployments.
A collaborative multi-agent system framework for autonomous network diagnosis, maintenance, and recovery with minimal human intervention.
A paradigm shift method from 'Network for AI' to 'AI for Network' that natively integrates AI into 6G architecture.
A multi-modal, multi-task optimization framework unifying network management as a single optimization problem using foundation model.

title: Teaching AI Through Benchmark Construction: QuestBench as a Course-Based Practice for Accountable Knowledge Work
summary: As AI becomes part of everyday learning, many courses teach students to use it mainly as a productivity tool: how to prompt, search, summarize, write, code, and use tools more efficiently. We argue that AI education also needs a setting in which students learn to test AI and understand their own role in judging machine-produced knowledge. To this end, we introduce a course-based practice that teaches AI through benchmark construction, using deep research systems as a concrete example of AI-era knowledge work. Students turn disciplinary knowledge into verifiable expert-level questions, review one another's designs for ambiguity and shortcuts, and evaluate AI systems on the resulting tasks. This activity gives students direct exposure to a powerful tool while asking them to specify what a trustworthy answer would require. The produced benchmark, QuestBench, consists of 256 questions across 14 humanities and social-science domains. Evaluation on QuestBench shows that student-designed tasks reveal hidden failures in current deep research systems: across thirteen evaluated systems, the mean question-level pass rate is only 16.85%, and the best-performing system, GPT-5.5, reaches a 57.58% pass rate. The failures are educationally useful because they show how fluent, source-backed answers can still miss the right query, source, term, or evidence standard. Reflections from five student contributors suggest that benchmark construction can help students see professional knowledge not only as content AI may retrieve, but as the basis for judging AI outputs. We present QuestBench as a benchmark artifact and as a reusable classroom setting for a larger educational question: how students can remain responsible knowledge actors as AI enters learning and professional work. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/PKUAIWeb/QuestBench/tree/main.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过基准构建教授AI的课程实践，让学生将学科知识转化为专家级问题并评估AI系统，构建了QuestBench数据集，发现当前深度研究系统在专业领域的平均通过率仅16.85%。
AI.motivation: 当前AI教育主要将AI作为生产力工具教授（如何提示、搜索、总结、编码等），缺乏让学生学会测试AI、理解自身在判断机器生成知识中的角色的教学场景。
AI.method: 引入基于基准构建的AI教学方法：学生将学科知识转化为可验证的专家级问题，通过互审消除歧义和捷径，并在生成的任务上评估AI系统。由此构建出QuestBench数据集（256个问题，14个人文社科领域），并评估了13个深度研究系统。
AI.result: QuestBench包含256个问题，13个评估系统平均通过率仅16.85%，最佳系统GPT-5.5通过率57.58%。学生设计的任务揭示了深度研究系统的隐藏失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 通过让学生构建基准测试（QuestBench），可以培养他们在AI时代批判性评估AI输出、保持专业知识判断能力，而不仅仅将AI视为效率工具。
idea_en: A method for constructing AI benchmarks based on student-designed expert-level questions, where disciplinary knowledge is transformed into verifiable questions and peer review eliminates ambiguity and shortcuts. (QuestBench methodology)

A mechanism for discovering hidden failures in deep research AI systems using expert-level question sets (QuestBench), revealing systematic failures in query understanding, term accuracy, and evidence standard matching across 13 evaluated systems.
An AI education method that transforms students from passive AI tool users into active knowledge judges through benchmark construction, maintaining professional knowledge judgment authority.

A cross-disciplinary AI evaluation benchmark dataset (QuestBench) containing 256 expert-level questions across 14 humanities and social science domains, designed to expose knowledge blind spots and reasoning defects in deep research systems.

title: PALS: Power-Aware LLM Serving for Mixture-of-Experts Models
summary: Large language model (LLM) inference has become a dominant workload in modern data centers, driving significant GPU utilization and energy consumption. While prior systems optimize throughput and latency by batching, scheduling, and parallelism, they largely treat GPU power as a static constraint rather than a controllable resource. In this paper, we present a power-aware runtime for LLM serving, PALS, that treats GPU power caps as a first-class control knob and jointly optimizes them with software parameters such as batch size. The system combines lightweight offline power-performance models with a feedback-driven controller to select configurations that satisfy throughput targets while maximizing energy efficiency. We implement PALS within an existing LLM serving framework, vLLM, demonstrating that it requires no model retraining or API changes. Across multi-GPU systems and both dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, PALS improves energy efficiency by up to 26.3%, reduces QoS violations by 4x to 7x under power constraints, and tracks dynamic power budgets. These results highlight the potential of integrating power control directly into LLM inference runtimes, enabling energy-proportional and grid-interactive AI systems.

AI.tldr: PALS是一个面向LLM推理的功耗感知运行时系统，通过将GPU功耗上限作为可调控资源，结合离线功耗模型和反馈驱动控制器，在不改变模型或API的情况下，在满足吞吐目标的同时最大化能效。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理系统通过批处理、调度和并行化优化吞吐量和延迟，但将GPU功耗视为静态约束而非可控制资源，导致能效利用不充分。
AI.method: PALS结合轻量级离线功耗-性能模型与反馈驱动控制器，将GPU功耗上限作为一等控制参数，与批量大小等软件参数联合优化，选择满足吞吐目标同时最大化能效的配置。
AI.result: 在多GPU系统及密集型和MoE模型上，PALS能效提升最高26.3%，在功耗约束下QoS违规减少4-7倍，并能动态跟踪功耗预算。
AI.conclusion: 将功耗控制直接集成到LLM推理运行时中，可实现能量比例计算和电网交互式AI系统，具有显著潜力。
idea_en: A power-aware LLM serving runtime that treats GPU power caps as a first-class controllable resource jointly optimized with software parameters
A lightweight offline power-performance modeling approach for LLM inference that enables configuration selection under throughput targets
A feedback-driven controller that dynamically adjusts GPU power caps and batch sizes to track power budgets while minimizing QoS violations

title: Mind the Sim-to-Real Gap & Think Like a Scientist
summary: Suppose a planner has a pre-trained simulator of a sequential decision problem and the option to run real experiments in the field. The simulator is cheap to query but inherits confounding and drift from its calibration data. Experimentation is unbiased but consumes one real unit per trial. We study when, and how, the planner should supplement the simulator with experiments. We give three results. First, an extended simulation lemma decomposes the simulator's value error into a calibration--deployment shift that randomization can identify and a parametric residual that no further interaction can reduce. Second, the value gap between the simulator-optimal policy and the optimum splits into a local component, on states the deployed policy already visits, and a reachability component, on states it does not. The reachability component stays bounded away from zero at any horizon under purely passive learning. Third, we propose Fisher-SEP, a simulation-aided experimental policy (SEP) that minimizes the posterior predictive variance of a target policy's value, with reward-only and transition-only specializations. Two case studies illustrate the regimes. In a vending-machine supply chain, front-loaded experimentation overtakes posterior updating once the horizon is long enough to amortize the pilot. In an HIV mobile-testing example with a corridor that separates a well-surveilled region from a poorly-surveilled one, only designed exploration reaches the poorly-surveilled region.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在存在低成本但有偏模拟器与高成本但无偏真实实验的情况下，规划者如何最优地结合两者进行序贯决策。提出了Fisher-SEP算法，通过模拟辅助实验策略最小化目标策略价值后验预测方差，并给出了模拟器价值误差的分解定理与最优策略价值差距的局部-可达性分解。
AI.motivation: 现实决策中常存在低成本但存在混杂和漂移偏差的模拟器，以及无偏但昂贵（每次消耗一个真实单元）的真实实验。需要研究何时以及如何用真实实验补充模拟器，以在预算约束下获得最佳策略价值估计。
AI.method: 1) 扩展仿真引理，将模拟器价值误差分解为随机化可识别的标定-部署偏移和参数残差；2) 将模拟器最优策略与真实最优策略的价值差距分解为局部分量（已访问状态）和可达性分量（未访问状态）；3) 提出Fisher-SEP算法，通过最小化目标策略价值的后验预测方差来设计模拟辅助实验，并给出仅奖励和仅转移两种特化版本。
AI.result: 两个案例研究展示了不同机制：在自动售货机供应链中，当时间跨度足够长时，前期实验投入可通过摊销超越后期贝叶斯更新；在HIV移动检测案例中，只有设计探索才能到达监控较差的区域。
AI.conclusion: 提供了何时以及如何用真实实验补充模拟器的理论框架和实用算法，弥合了低成本模拟与高成本真实实验之间的鸿沟。

title: AiraXiv: An AI-Driven Open-Access Platform for Human and AI Scientists
summary: Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) have accelerated the growth of both human-authored and AI-generated research outputs, placing increasing strain on traditional academic publishing systems and challenging the scalability of conference- and journal-centered paradigms amid rising submission volumes, reviewer workload, and venue size. To address these challenges, we explore an AI-era publishing paradigm in which both human and AI scientists participate as authors and readers, and papers evolve through continuous, feedback-driven iteration. We propose AiraXiv, an AI-driven open-access platform built on open preprints, AI-augmented analysis and review, and reader feedback. AiraXiv supports human scientists through an interactive UI and AI scientists through Model Context Protocol (MCP)-based interactions. We validate AiraXiv through real-world deployments, including serving as the submission platform for ICAIS 2025, demonstrating its potential as a fast, inclusive, and scalable research infrastructure for the AI era. AiraXiv is publicly available at https://airaxiv.com.

AI.tldr: AiraXiv是一个AI驱动的开放获取平台，支持人类和AI科学家共同参与论文的提交、审稿和迭代，旨在解决传统学术出版系统在AI时代面临的规模化和效率挑战。
AI.motivation: 传统学术出版系统面临投稿量激增、审稿人负担加重、会议规模膨胀等问题，亟需一种更快速、包容、可扩展的新型出版范式。
AI.method: 提出AiraXiv平台，基于开放预印本、AI增强的分析与审稿、读者反馈机制；为人类科学家提供交互式UI，为AI科学家提供基于MCP（Model Context Protocol）的交互接口。
AI.result: 通过实际部署验证，包括作为ICAIS 2025的投稿平台，证明了其作为快速、包容、可扩展的研究基础设施的潜力。
AI.conclusion: AiraXiv展示了在AI时代，人类与AI科学家共同参与、论文持续迭代的出版范式的可行性。

title: DeepWeb-Bench: A Deep Research Benchmark Demanding Massive Cross-Source Evidence and Long-Horizon Derivation
comment: Work in Progress. 27 pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://sixiongxie1001-dot.github.io/deep-research-benchmark2.0
summary: Deep research, in which an agent searches the open web, collects evidence, and derives an answer through extended reasoning, is a prominent use case for frontier language models. Frontier deep research products score high on existing benchmarks, making it difficult to distinguish their capabilities from current evaluation data alone. We introduce DeepWeb-Bench, a deep research benchmark that is substantially harder than existing benchmarks for the current frontier. Difficulty comes from three properties of the data itself: each task requires massive evidence collection, cross-source reconciliation, and long-horizon multi-step derivation. We represent these three sources of difficulty as four capability families (Retrieval, Derivation, Reasoning, and Calibration) and report results sliced by family. Every reference answer is accompanied by a source-provenance record with four disclosure levels and cross-source checks where available, making scores easier to audit against the underlying evidence. We evaluate DeepWeb-Bench on nine frontier models and report three findings: (1) retrieval is not the bottleneck, as retrieval failures account for only 12-14% of errors while derivation and calibration failures account for over 70%; (2) strong and weak models fail in qualitatively different ways, with strong models' errors dominated by incomplete derivation and weak models' by hallucinated precision; and (3) models exhibit genuine specialization across domains, with cross-model agreement of only rho = 0.61 and per-case disagreement reaching 18.8 percentage points. The public benchmark release includes the data, rubrics, and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 提出了DeepWeb-Bench，一个更难、更深入的AI研究基准测试，发现检索不是瓶颈（仅占12-14%错误），而推导和校准失败占70%以上，强弱模型失败模式有本质区别。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿深度研究产品在已有基准测试上得分很高，难以区分模型能力差异，需要更难的基准来评估AI模型的深度研究能力。
AI.method: 构建DeepWeb-Bench基准，每个任务需要大规模证据收集、跨源调和、长时程多步推导。定义四个能力族（检索、推导、推理、校准），每个参考答案附带来源溯源记录（四级披露）和交叉源检查。
AI.result: 在9个前沿模型上评估发现：(1)检索仅占12-14%错误，推导和校准占70%以上；(2)强模型错误以不完整推导为主，弱模型以幻觉精度为主；(3)模型在领域间存在真实专业化差异，跨模型一致性仅rho=0.61。
AI.conclusion: DeepWeb-Bench能有效区分模型深度研究能力，揭示了模型间质性差异和失败模式差异，为深度研究评估提供了更严格的基准。
idea_en: A deep research benchmark with source-provenance records and four-level disclosure tracking, enabling auditable evaluation of AI reasoning chains against cited evidence.
A cross-source reconciliation evaluation methodology that measures an AI agent's ability to harmonize conflicting information from multiple web sources during deep research tasks.
A capability-family slicing evaluation framework (Retrieval, Derivation, Reasoning, Calibration) that disentangles and measures distinct failure modes in AI deep research systems.
A calibration metric for deep research systems that detects 'hallucinated precision' - the tendency of weaker models to produce overly specific but incorrect answers.
